name: ARK 90 (Hubble)
blurb: ARK 90, an early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ark90-hubble
story: One of 16 nearby early-type galaxies Hubble imaged in a hunt for the most massive black holes hiding in small galaxies.

claims.text: ARK90 is a target of HST program 13050 at RA 02 42 29.035, Dec +18 09 52.88, matching this pointing (RA 40.621, Dec 18.1647)
The program imaged 16 nearby early-type galaxies
The program is titled The Most Massive Black Holes in Small Galaxies
